rationale: The mass reads as a single elongated roofed ribbon with a clear folded section and consistent sectional logic across views. It is coherent in plan and elevation, with a dominant bar and modest secondary articulation rather than scattered fragments. The silhouette does not depend mainly on stepback massing, though the terraced language is present. The main weakness is limited public void: the form is mostly a compact slab/bar with only slight undercut or terrace voids, so the open-ground/courtyard logic is not yet strong. Geometry appears clean and unlikely to be over-clipped, with no obvious view-to-view collisions.
warnings: Void expression is weak; the object reads more like a ribbon bar than a spatially porous mass.
Terrace logic is present but subdued, so the project may need a more legible cutout or undercroft if public openness is intended.
